Collection includes brands like Blair's Death Sauce, Woopin Ass, BBQ Sauce from Hell, Cactus Dust seasoning, and many other gourmet spicy condiments. For display only.

items.title: Viagra Promotional Wall Clock and Picture Frame Set
items.ai_notes: [Viagra promotional wall clock and picture frame] Niche pharmaceutical promotional items have very limited appeal and are essentially novelty collectibles.
items.description: Blue and white Viagra branded wall clock with working mechanism featuring sildenafil citrate tablets branding, accompanied by matching black promotional picture frame or display stand. Clock shows Pfizer branding and includes battery compartment manufactured by Harrison-Daniels Inc.

items.title: Actos Pioglitazone HCl Pharmaceutical Wall Clock
items.ai_notes: [Actos pharmaceutical promotional wall clock] Highly niche pharmaceutical promotional item; very limited market.
items.description: Purple framed wall clock featuring Actos medication branding with colorful cartoon characters representing different dosage amounts of 15mg, 30mg, and 45mg pioglitazone HCl. Medical promotional item with working clock mechanism.

items.title: Pharmaceutical Promotional Wall Clocks Set
items.ai_notes: [Set of 2 pharmaceutical promotional wall clocks] Promotional medical clocks are generally considered junk/clutter by most buyers.
items.description: Two wall clocks featuring pharmaceutical branding - one Bextra valdecoxib tablets clock with silver frame and red/blue star logo, and one Pletal cilostazol clock with blue frame. Both feature quartz movements and are promotional items from medical companies.

items.title: Promotional Wall Clocks Set - Isoprtin SR and Valtrex
items.ai_notes: [Set of 2 pharmaceutical promotional wall clocks] Even in original packaging, these are low-demand promotional items.
items.description: Set of two white promotional wall clocks featuring pharmaceutical branding for Isoprtin SR and Valtrex medications. Quartz movement with battery operation, includes original packaging and instruction manual. Clock mechanism visible on back with standard AA battery compartment.

items.title: Medical Office Lot with Entex LA Medication and Carondelet Health Calculator
items.ai_notes: [Medical office promotional lot] A collection of branded promotional items with almost no resale value.
items.description: Collection of medical office items including Entex LA phenylpropanolamine HCI guaifenesin medication container, Carondelet Health branded calculator with world time zones and wood trim, and Aladdin lens cap. Mixed pharmaceutical and office equipment suitable for medical practice or collector.

items.title: Desk Clock Collection Mixed Brands
items.ai_notes: [Desk clock collection] Mixed lot of promotional desk clocks; very low demand.
items.description: Collection of desk clocks including blue Preferred Hospice promotional clock with quartz movement, clear acrylic Optel desk clock, and Biaxin promotional timepiece. Various styles and sizes suitable for office or home use.
